subject: Marketplace renewal — onboarding playbook & usage rebaseline
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-analytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace renewal: committing to annual + evidence window

Hi Logan,

Hope you had a good week. Following our call, Acme would like to move forward with an annualized commitment and increase capacity by ~20% over our current baseline. Legal/procurement are ready to proceed but need clear steps for the AWS Marketplace private offer acceptance and the evidence we need to provide for usage/acceptance.

Key asks from procurement:
- Timeline for private offer creation + acceptance window (we prefer acceptance by July 15)
- Exact list of evidence buckets (SOC 2 evidence, invoice/usage export, test calls)
- How billing will be sequenced (prorated first invoice vs. staggered tranches)

Can you share your onboarding playbook and confirm who at Redwood will own the PO/private offer creation? I've looped in our AP contact for billing: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m slot if helpful.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: committing to annual + evidence window

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we can meet your July 15 acceptance target, and Redwood will create the AWS Private Offer (we own the submission). Marissa will lead the legal/PO coordination and Ben will own billing sequencing.

I'm attaching our onboarding playbook (Onboarding_Playbook_v2.docx) which outlines the acceptance evidence package. Highlights:
- Evidence: SOC 2 attestation + a 14-day usage export (CSV), a sample invoice and a short test-plan we run to validate prefix caching and baseline throughput.
- Timeline: Private offer created by Redwood within 48 hours of signed PO; acceptance window 7 calendar days from private-offer publish.
- Billing: default is: prorated invoice for remainder of month + monthly invoices thereafter. If you prefer tranches we can stagger; Ben, can you propose a two-tranche plan?

Action items:
1) Acme to send signed PO to ap@acme-analytics.com and cc us (you did say AP is the contact).
2) Redwood to create private offer and send DocuSign link for acceptance.
3) Exchange evidence package during acceptance window (Marissa will track).

HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/5472

I'll schedule a 30m sync if that helps — propose Wed 7/4 10am PT.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Marketplace
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Onboarding_Playbook_v2.docx (docx)

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-analytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: committing to annual + evidence window

Thanks Logan — attaching the signed PO (ACME_PO_5472_signed.pdf). We want the private offer to bill to our AWS payer account listed on the PO (see page 1). Please send the private offer to ap@acme-analytics.com and cc our procurement inbox.

A couple of clarifications from finance:
- We'll need a clear invoice schedule in writing before acceptance.
- Please confirm tax handling (we're US-based, but our entity is in Delaware).

I'm good for the Wed 7/4 10am PT sync — please send calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samantha

Attachment: ACME_PO_5472_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-analytics.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: committing to annual + evidence window

Hi Samantha — looping in Redwood legal/ops to confirm a couple of small items before we create the private offer.

Notes from legal:
- Term: Acme asked about annualizing the commitment; Redwood prefers a 24-month minimum for committed discounts on this product. If you need 12 months we can provide a transitional credit schedule — happy to discuss.
- SLA uplift: please confirm if you require a written SLA tier; that affects the private-offer price.

Ben — can you propose a two-tranche invoicing schedule (prorated up-front + remainder at 90 days)? Also confirm whether Redwood can issue invoices to Acme's AWS payer or if we should bill Acme directly (finance preference noted).

Samantha — attaching the evidence checklist we typically use for marketplace acceptance. During the 7-day acceptance window we'll ask for: SOC 2 report (redacted ok), 14-day usage export, and a signed acceptance confirmation. We'll upload the evidence bundle to the acceptance portal and share the link.

Next steps:
- Acme confirms term preference (12 vs 24 months) and SLA requirement.
- Ben to propose invoicing cadence by EOD 7/5.
- Redwood to draft the private offer once terms confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Marketplace_Evidence_Package.zip (zip)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: committing to annual + evidence window

Samantha — thanks for the signed PO and for the clarifications. Quick update and action register: 

1) Term: Acme confirmed you prefer a 12-month cadence. Redwood can support 12 months with a small onboarding credit applied month 2; Marissa will document the credit in the private-offer notes.
2) Billing sequence: Ben proposes (and Acme confirmed) — prorated invoice on acceptance + second invoice at 90 days for the remainder of year one. Ben: please confirm the invoice remit address (do we send to ap@acme-analytics.com or bill via AWS payer?).
3) Private offer: Redwood has created the offer and pushed to AWS Marketplace. DocuSign link for acceptance and the private-offer pdf are attached. Please accept by 2028-07-15 to meet your target.
4) Evidence: Marissa will upload the evidence package during the acceptance window — please share SOC 2 and the 14-day export there.

I've attached the private-offer stub (ACME_PrivateOffer_PO_5472.pdf) and updated the HubSpot deal notes: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/5472.

If helpful, we can run a 15m walkthrough of the acceptance portal — otherwise we'll wait for the DocuSign execution.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Marketplace
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_PrivateOffer_PO_5472.pdf (pdf), Onboarding_Playbook_v2.docx (docx)
